articles.abstract_en: How should mediators communicate with bargainers? When can they improve outcomes? Can arbitrators that impose outcomes do better? I provide answers in wars of attrition with flexible and commitment types, consistent with reputational bargaining. I characterize the unique mediated equilibrium, which maximizes flexible types’ payoffs. The mediator immediately elicits private information but waits to suggest agreements. She front-loads agreements between flexible types, while initially delaying any involving commitment types. This improves on unmediated outcomes only if commitment probabilities are less than agents’ payoff share in their preferred agreement. Arbitrators do strictly better but sometimes impose disagreement, which may be hard to enforce.
articles.abstract_cn: 调解人应如何与谈判者沟通？他们何时能改善结果？强加结果的仲裁者能否做得更好？我在具有灵活型和承诺型的消耗战中提供答案，这与声誉性讨价还价一致。我刻画了唯一的调解均衡，该均衡最大化灵活型的收益。调解人立即引出私人信息，但等待建议协议。她将灵活型之间的协议前置，而最初延迟涉及承诺型的协议。只有当承诺概率小于代理人在其偏好协议中的收益份额时，这才优于无调解结果。仲裁者严格做得更好，但有时强加分歧，这可能难以执行。

articles.title_en: Shocks and Technology Adoption: Evidence from Electronic Payment Systems
articles.title_cn: 冲击与技术采纳：来自电子支付系统的证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide evidence on the importance of coordination frictions in technology adoption, using data from a large provider of electronic wallets during the Indian demonetization. Exploiting geographical variation in exposure to the demonetization, we show that adoption of the wallet increased persistently in response to the large but temporary cash contraction, consistent with the predictions of a technology adoption model with complementarities. Model estimates indicate that adoption would have been 45% lower without complementarities. Our results illustrate how large but temporary interventions can help overcome coordination frictions, though we caution that such interventions may also exacerbate initial differences in adoption.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用印度废钞期间一家大型电子钱包提供商的数据，提供了关于协调摩擦在技术采纳中重要性的证据。利用废钞暴露程度的地理差异，我们表明，钱包的采纳在应对大规模但暂时的现金紧缩时持续增加，这与具有互补性的技术采纳模型的预测一致。模型估计表明，如果没有互补性，采纳率将降低45%。我们的结果说明，大规模但暂时的干预措施如何帮助克服协调摩擦，尽管我们警告此类干预也可能加剧初始采纳差异。

articles.title_en: Information Frictions, Reputation, and Sovereign Spreads
articles.title_cn: 信息摩擦、声誉与主权利差
articles.abstract_en: We formulate a reputational model in which the type of government is time varying and private information. Agents adjust their beliefs about the government’s type (i.e., reputation) using noisy signals about its policies. We consider a debt repayment setting in which reputation influences the market’s perceived probability of default, which affects sovereign spreads. We focus on the 2007–12 Argentine episode of inflation misreport to quantify how markets price reputation. We find that the misreports significantly increased Argentina’s sovereign spreads. We use those estimates to discipline our model and show that reputation can have long-lasting effects on a government’s borrowing costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个声誉模型，其中政府类型随时间变化且为私人信息。代理人通过关于政府政策的噪声信号来调整其对政府类型（即声誉）的信念。我们考虑一个债务偿还环境，其中声誉影响市场感知的违约概率，进而影响主权利差。我们聚焦于2007年12月阿根廷的通胀误报事件，以量化市场如何为声誉定价。我们发现，误报显著提高了阿根廷的主权利差。我们利用这些估计来约束我们的模型，并表明声誉可能对政府的借贷成本产生长期影响。

articles.title_cn: 残疾保险收入挽救生命
articles.abstract_en: We show that higher payments from US Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) reduce mortality. Using administrative data on new DI beneficiaries, we exploit discontinuities in the benefit formula through a regression kink design. We estimate that $1,000 more in annual DI payments decreases the annual mortality rate of lower-income beneficiaries by approximately 0.18–0.35 percentage points, implying an elasticity of mortality with respect to DI income of around −0.6 to −1.0. We find no robust evidence of an effect of DI income on the mortality of higher-income beneficiaries.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，美国社会保障残疾保险（DI）的更高支付降低了死亡率。利用新DI受益人的行政数据，我们通过回归扭结设计利用福利公式中的不连续性。我们估计，年度DI支付每增加1000美元，低收入受益人的年死亡率降低约0.18至0.35个百分点，这意味着死亡率对DI收入的弹性约为-0.6至-1.0。我们没有发现DI收入对高收入受益人死亡率影响的稳健证据。

articles.abstract_en: We study informed persuasion, whereby a privately informed designer without ex ante commitment power chooses disclosure mechanisms to influence agents’ actions. We characterize the subset of Bayes-correlated equilibria yielding every designer type a payoff higher than what they could get from any disclosure mechanism with credible beliefs. This set of interim-optimal mechanisms is nonempty and tractable, and all its elements are perfect Bayesian equilibrium mechanisms of the informed-designer game. Interim-optimal mechanisms are characterized via belief-based approaches in pure persuasion settings. We identify single- and multiagent interactive environments in which ex ante–optimal mechanisms are interim optimal.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究知情说服，即一个拥有私人信息且没有事前承诺能力的设计者选择披露机制以影响代理人的行动。我们刻画了贝叶斯相关均衡的子集，该子集使得每种设计者类型获得的收益高于他们从任何具有可信信念的披露机制中能获得的收益。这一组中期最优机制是非空且易于处理的，并且其所有元素都是知情设计者博弈中的完美贝叶斯均衡机制。在纯说服环境中，中期最优机制通过基于信念的方法来刻画。我们识别了单一和多个代理的互动环境，在这些环境中，事前最优机制是中期最优的。

articles.title_en: Public Debt as Private Liquidity: Optimal Policy
articles.title_cn: 公共债务作为私人流动性：最优政策
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal policy in an economy where interest rates are low because public debt serves as collateral or buffer stock. Issuing more public debt raises welfare by easing the underlying friction but also reduces the private valuation of this service, raising interest rates. This trade-off shapes the optimal quantity of public debt in the long run, justifies a departure from tax smoothing in the short run, and calls for larger deficits during financial crises. Our analysis illustrates the possible robustness of these insights to different microfoundations and helps clarify when exactly low interest rates represent an opportunity for cheap government borrowing.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个经济中的最优政策，在该经济中，由于公共债务充当抵押品或缓冲库存，利率较低。发行更多公共债务通过缓解潜在摩擦来提高福利，但也降低了这种服务的私人估值，从而提高了利率。这种权衡塑造了长期公共债务的最优数量，证明了短期内偏离税收平滑的合理性，并呼吁在金融危机期间增加赤字。我们的分析说明了这些见解对不同微观基础的可能稳健性，并有助于澄清低利率究竟在何时代表廉价政府借款的机会。
